summary: Great thought from https://martijn.vanderven.s "It is interesting how the industry is self-sabotaging a bit on the PHP thing. [I knew someone] was seeing the same: his trade school spent whole courses on node and JavaScript, and then sends their students out to work on ecommerce solutions that are all written in PHP (Drupal Commerce, WordPress stuff, etc.)"
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Great thought from https://martijn.vanderven.s "It is interesting how the industry is self-sabotaging a bit on the PHP thing. [I knew someone] was seeing the same: his trade school spent whole courses on node and JavaScript, and then sends their students out to work on ecommerce solutions that are all written in PHP (Drupal Commerce, WordPress stuff, etc.)"
